judge.rationale: The candidate delivers a complete, bug-free solution that satisfies every acceptance criterion in the issue. It accurately accumulates per-round usage across tool calls, handles missing round usage without producing NaN or undefined, leaves the existing single-round test untouched, and updates the hook parameter name (`turnUsage` with JSDoc), specs, and CHANGELOG appropriately. It even improves slightly on the reference's test coverage by explicitly testing a turn with two tool rounds (three total provider calls) as requested by the first acceptance criterion, whereas the reference tested one tool round for the full sum. The closeness to reference score is 4 rather than 5 because the candidate extracts `accumulateUsage` into `orchestratorHelpers.ts` and splits test helpers and new test cases into three new files (`chatOrchestratorTestSupport.ts`, `turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts`, and `usageAccumulation.test.ts`), whereas the reference keeps the helper and tests inline within `chatOrchestrator.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
